rotate.text: Turn your device: Legend of Morvath is played lying down.

boot.error: Something went wrong while loading. Please reload the page.
boot.dataErrors: {count} problems found in the game data.

title.overwriteQuestion: Starting a new game will erase your current save. Are you sure?

settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteConfirm1: Delete your save? You will start completely over.
settings.deleteConfirm2: Are you really sure? This cannot be undone.
settings.browserDataWarning: Your game is saved in this browser. Clearing your browser data also deletes your save.

save.newerVersion: This save was made with a newer version of the game. Reload the page to update.
save.corrupt: Your save could not be read. A backup copy was kept.
save.storageUnavailable: Saving is not possible in this browser (private mode?). Your progress will not be kept.
save.importInvalid: This code is not a valid save.

creator.title: Create your character
creator.name: Name
creator.nameInvalid: Use up to {max} letters and numbers.
creator.startItems: Starting gear: {weapon} and {mantle} in your mantle color.

stats.title: Your stats
stats.hint: Spend your points. You get one more every level, and you can always change your mind here before you begin.
stats.softCap: Above {n} points a point gives less.

desc.power: Your normal attacks hit harder, with a sword and with a staff.
desc.magic_power: Spells hit harder, and your staff’s normal attack a little.
desc.regen: Energy comes back faster. A mage also gets mana back, a sword fighter health.
desc.dexterity: You swing, cast and charge faster.
desc.luck: A bigger chance of a critical hit.

reset.title: Build yourself again
reset.hint: Sultan took your egg and freed every point. Your level, your path, your gear and your quests stay as they are.

intro.panel_1: Five thousand years ago, two wizards slew a god.
intro.panel_2: Lucael and Baelor took his power. But they had lost all faith in humanity, and so they turned to darkness.
intro.panel_3: Ever since, as the Lords of Morvath, they have spread their corruption across the land.
intro.lucael: Is this all humanity has left?
intro.baelor: You're not even worth killing, little insect. Come back when you're stronger.
intro.panel_5: Few have faced the Lords of Morvath and lived.
intro.panel_6: You wake in the Monastery of Greyhaven. Your journey begins here.

cine.greeting: Something came through the mist door, Brother.
cine.reply: Ooh. A small one. Do you think it bites?
cine.enough: Enough. Let me see it properly.
cine.palm: Oh, it has a tiny sword. Look, Brother, it's furious!

fight.hint: Attack them! {keyAttack} strikes, {keyHeavy} is an explosion, {keyPotion} calls thunder, {keyLock} fires an icicle.
fight.hintTouch: Tap Attack, Explosion, Thunder or Icicle.
fight.clickToLook: Click to look around · hold Esc to skip
fight.wonder: What do we do with it?
fight.keep: Keep it! Look at it go.
fight.name: It's trying so hard. Can we at least name it?
fight.fine: Fine. Fine! One look, and then it goes.
fight.freeze: Time bends to us. Not to you.

pringle.2: Did you really think you could just leave?
pringle.4: I am Sultan. Show me you're ready for the world out there.

brink_tower.1: Ah, a visitor in my tower. Come in, come in. Mind the candles.
brink_tower.2: Normal magic draws on the elements: water, fire, nature and wind. Every mage gets one of them, through a crystal on the staff.
brink_tower.3: It starts slowly, I won't lie. But magic rewards those who are patient. In the end, this is the strongest path.

sam_cellar.1: Hm. Not many visitors find their way down here.
sam_cellar.2: My magic comes from Lucael and Baelor themselves. I don't serve them. I use their own power against them.
sam_cellar.3: Dark magic is strong, and quickly. But remember: it is a dark road.

crystal_ceremony.1: Do not reach. A crystal is not taken; it is given.
crystal_ceremony.2: There — {element}. That one has made up its mind about you.
crystal_ceremony.3: Hold still. This part always tingles.
crystal_ceremony.4: Your {crystal} is set. It carries {spell}; everything else you will have to earn.

sultanEnd.claws: Heh… you've got claws after all.
sultanEnd.watch: From now on, I'll keep an eye on you.
sultanEnd.ask: Lost? Can't find something you need? Come and ask me. I know every corner of this land… and where everything in it is hidden.
sultanEnd.egg: Here. Keep this. You'll understand later.

hud.rested: You rest in your bed. HP and mana are full again.
hud.qualityLowered: Graphics lowered to {quality} to keep the game smooth.
hud.qualityChosen: Graphics set to {quality} for this device. You can change it in Settings.
hud.levelUp: Level up! You are now level {level}.
hud.gearInCombat: You can't change gear during a fight.
hud.packInCombat: Not now, you are in a fight.
hud.statPoint: You have a stat point. Open your status window with {keyStatus}.
hud.statPoints: You have {n} stat points. Open your status window with {keyStatus}.
hud.statsReturned: Levels no longer grow by themselves: your {n} points are yours to spend ({keyStatus}).
hud.eggFound: You found the {name}. Sultan trades an egg for a new build.
hud.statsReset: Your {n} points are free again. Spread them as you like.
hud.drillLeft: You left the field, so the drill starts again. Step back onto it when you are ready.
hud.noOffhand: Nothing to hold in your off hand yet.
hud.noItem: Nothing to use from the quick slot.

chosen.sword: Your path: sword fighter. Sir Garrick is your teacher.
chosen.light: Your path: light magic. Master Brink is your teacher.
chosen.dark: Your path: dark magic. Wizard Sam is your teacher.

place.monastery: The Monastery is your checkpoint. If you fall, you wake up here. Rest in your bed to recover.
place.market_square: The Market Square: buy and sell goods. The stalls change all the time.
place.forge: You can trade gold for upgrades or new items.
place.alchemy_lab: In the Alchemy Lab you brew potions and learn new recipes.
place.golden_kettle: The Golden Kettle: everyone comes here for stories, rumors and hints.
place.garden: In the Garden you can grow your own herbs. They keep growing while you are away.
place.academy: The Academy, where mages are trained. Your path will be chosen here.
place.training_field: The training field. Sword fighters sharpen their skills here.
place.harbor: The harbor of Greyhaven. Ships come and go across the bay.
place.city_gate_blocked: You are not ready to leave the city yet.
place.old_tjikko: Old Tjikko, the ancient tree. The elves draw their magic from it.
place.elven_city: The city of the elves, high in the branches. Treewardens are never attacked here.
place.aqueduct: The aqueduct bridge carries the river into the city. Mist hangs above the water.
place.watchtower: The watchtower keeps an eye on the northern coast.
place.greenwood_shrine: A small elven shrine. It is your checkpoint in the Greenwood.
place.wortelgrotten: Roots block the entrance to De Wortelgrotten. Something stirs deep below.
place.mournfen_monastery: A wooden monastery on stilts, high above the wet ground. It is your checkpoint in the Mournfen.

brother_ansel.1: Welcome back. The Monastery's doors are always open to you.
brother_ansel.2: Remember: should you fall, you will wake up here again.
brother_ansel.3: Rest in your bed whenever you are tired. Greyhaven awaits.

marco.1: Welcome, welcome! Everything here is special, just for you.
marco.2: Come back soon. My stock changes every day!

hilda.1: HA! A new face! Bring me gold and materials and I'll make that sword sing.
hilda.2: I can also break old gear down into materials.

fizzwick.1: Oh! Mind the smoke. My eyebrows will grow back, I'm sure of it.
fizzwick.2: Bring me ingredients and I'll teach you a recipe or two.

rose.1: Hello, dear. The Garden is a quiet place. Plants need patience.
rose.2: Fresh herbs dry by themselves after a few days. Dried ones still have their uses.

bertha.1: Come in, come in! Sit by the fire. What can I get you?
bertha.2: They say the Lords of Morvath slew a god, long ago. Brr.
bertha.3: If you're ever stuck, come and ask me. I hear everything.

master_brink.1: Welcome to the Academy. Magic rewards those who are patient.
master_brink.2: Come back when you are ready to choose your path.

offer.1: Ah, the one who faced Sultan. Word travels fast in this tower.
offer.2: I teach the magic of the world itself: Water, Fire, Nature and Wind. Your staff will carry one of them.
offer.3: My path starts slowly. But patience is rewarded: in the end, no magic burns brighter.

master_brink.confirm: Are you sure? Once you say yes, light magic is your path for the rest of the game.

accepted.1: Then welcome, student. Patience, practice, and a little curiosity. That is all I ask.
accepted.2: Your Entrance Exam will be ready soon. Come and see me then.

master_brink.declined: Take your time. Patience, remember? My door stays open.
master_brink.student: Your Entrance Exam is not ready yet. Patience, student.
master_brink.otherPath: You chose another path. I hope you know where it leads.

wizard_sam.1: Hm. Not many visitors find their way to me.
wizard_sam.2: Dark magic is strong, quickly. Remember that it is a dark road.

offer.1: You came all the way down the stairs. Most turn back halfway.
offer.2: What I teach is the magic of Lucael and Baelor. Their own power, turned against them. It is strong from the very first day.
offer.3: But hear me well: it is a dark path. It grows weaker as you grow older, and it does not let go of you easily.

wizard_sam.confirm: Are you sure? Once you say yes, dark magic is your path for the rest of the game.

accepted.1: So be it. Remember: you chose this. Nobody pushed you.
accepted.2: Your Entrance Exam will be ready soon. The cellar will be waiting.

wizard_sam.declined: Wise, perhaps. The cellar will still be here.
wizard_sam.student: Your Entrance Exam is not ready yet. Come back soon.
wizard_sam.otherPath: You chose the light, or the blade. Hm. We shall see who was right.

sir_garrick.1: A sword fighter stands in front and takes the blows for the team.
sir_garrick.2: Train hard, and steel will never let you down.

offer.1: So you are the one who beat Sultan with nothing but an old sword. Not bad at all.
offer.2: A blade never runs out of mana. Steel, sweat and a steady heart: that is all I teach. You stand in front and take the blows, so others can strike.

sir_garrick.confirm: Are you sure? Once you say yes, the sword is your path for the rest of the game.

accepted.1: Ha! Good. Then we start where every blademaster starts: on the training field.
accepted.2: Your Entrance Exam will be ready soon. Get some rest until then.

sir_garrick.declined: No shame in that. The field is here if you change your mind.
sir_garrick.student: Your Entrance Exam is not ready yet. Come back soon, student.
sir_garrick.otherPath: You chose another teacher. A pity; you have a good arm. Train hard anyway.

sultan.1: You fought well, little one. Pringle was only a disguise. Cats have their secrets.
sultan.2: Go on, the world is waiting. But when you are stronger, come back. I want a rematch.
sultan.3: Nine lives, remember? I still have eight.
sultan.4: And bring me eggs. One egg, and I will untangle everything you are. Do not ask how.

reset.1: An egg! Give it here, and I will shake you loose.
reset.2: Everything you learned stays. Only the way you are built comes apart.
reset.question: Spread all your points again? That costs one egg.
reset.confirm: Once more: the egg is mine and your build comes apart. Sure?
reset.accepted: Hold still. There. Now build yourself again.
reset.declined: Keep your egg then. I am not going anywhere.

find.greeting: Back again? Cats always know. Ask.
find.question: What are you looking for?
find.nothing: That one? Nobody has it yet. Not even me. Come back another time.
find.monster: {item}? Any {monster} might carry it. Look in {zone}.
find.boss: {item}? {monster} guards it, in {zone}. Bring your claws.
find.shop: {item}? {npc} sells it, in {zone}. For gold, of course.

gold.desc: Shiny coins. Used to buy, sell and upgrade.

travel_mantle.desc: A simple travel mantle with golden embroidery.

mage_staff.desc: A neutral staff. It only works with a crystal.

wizard_crystal.desc: A crystal with a random element: Water, Fire, Nature or Wind.

rookie_grimoire.desc: A small, plain spellbook. It holds one prepared incantation.

slime_gel.desc: Sticky gel left behind by a slime.

honed_old_sword.desc: Your old sword, honed by Hilda. Every hit does 3 more damage.

goblin_cleaver.desc: A crude, heavy goblin blade. Hits hard, but you feel every kilo.

chiefs_greatblade.desc: The Goblin Chief's pride. Enormous damage, enormous weight.

straw_hat.desc: Keeps the sun out of your eyes. Light as a feather.

leather_cap.desc: Simple boiled leather. Better than nothing.

iron_helm.desc: Solid iron. Strong protection, but heavy on your head.

padded_mantle.desc: A thick, quilted mantle that softens blows.

ironweave_mantle.desc: Woven with iron threads. Very strong, very heavy.

copper_amulet.desc: A simple charm that hums faintly with magic.

goblin_tooth_necklace.desc: Goblin teeth on a string. Somehow it makes you fiercer.

swift_ring.desc: Your steps feel a little lighter.

chiefs_signet.desc: The Goblin Chief's ring. Heavy with stolen gold.

heartwood_ring.desc: Carved from a fallen branch of Old Tjikko. It feels alive.

herb_seeds.desc: Seeds from Rose. You can plant them in your plot later.

academy_blade.desc: A straight, well-balanced blade from the Academy armoury. Heavier than your old sword, and it shows.

mossback_egg.desc: A mossy egg, warm to the touch. Sultan wants it.

rootgnarl_egg.desc: A bark-hard egg from the deep woods. Sultan wants it.

fenstalker_egg.desc: An egg out of the mud, still dripping. Sultan wants it.

bogmaw_egg.desc: A slimy egg from the fens. Sultan wants it.

hoarfrost_egg.desc: An egg of blue ice that never melts. Sultan wants it.

whisperer_egg.desc: An egg that hums when nobody speaks. Sultan wants it.

sentinel_egg.desc: A stone-grey egg from the old ruins. Sultan wants it.

stonejaw_egg.desc: An egg as heavy as the mountain it came from. Sultan wants it.

windlash_egg.desc: An egg that rocks in your hand on its own. Sultan wants it.

blightborn_egg.desc: An egg with a dark glow. Sultan wants it, and nobody asks why.

sultan_egg.desc: Sultan's own egg. He gave it to you after the fight: "You'll understand later."

adept_staff.desc: A staff with two spell slots. It only works with a crystal.

defeat_sultan.desc: Leave the city: defeat Sultan at the city gate.

your_resolve.objective: Choose a teacher: Sir Garrick, Master Brink or Wizard Sam
your_resolve.desc: Go to the Academy and choose your path. Sir Garrick waits on the training field, Master Brink in his tower and Wizard Sam in the cellar.

offer.1: Spring brings blossom. Could you bring me five?

progress.1: Five Blossom, dear. Only in spring.

first_harvest.desc: Bring Rose 5 Blossom from the Garden.

a_quiet_awakening.desc: Brother Ansel found you by the road. Rest in your bed at the Monastery.
a_quiet_awakening.objective: Rest in your bed at the Monastery

offer.1: Ah, you're awake. Easy now. I found you unconscious by the road, far from any town, and carried you here.
offer.2: This is the Monastery of Greyhaven. It is your checkpoint now: should you ever fall, you will wake up here again.
offer.3: Your bed is right over there. Lie down and rest a while; it heals body and mind. Come and see me when you feel better.

progress.1: Go on, rest in your bed first. Walk up to it and press {keyInteract} (or tap Rest).

complete.1: There, colour in your cheeks again. Whenever you are hurt, a bed at a checkpoint makes you whole.
complete.2: Take these coins for the road. Marco on the Market Square sells potions. Greyhaven is yours to explore.

just_for_you.desc: Buy 2 Health Potions from Marco on the Market Square.

offer.1: A new customer! And what a fine one. Today, and only for you, my Health Potions are a steal.
offer.2: Buy two, just to be safe. A wise traveller never leaves town without them. Trust me!

progress.1: Still thinking it over? Two Health Potions, special price, just for you.

complete.1: Pleasure doing business! Drink one with {keyPotion}, or tap the potion button, whenever you are hurt.
complete.2: Here, a little something back. Don't tell the other merchants.

steel_and_slime.desc: Bring Hilda 3 Slime Gel from the slimes in the yard by the north-east city wall. She will hone your old sword.

offer.1: HA! That rusty old thing is your sword? It couldn't cut butter on a summer day!
offer.2: I can hone it for you. But I need Slime Gel to polish the steel. Three blobs of it.
offer.3: A few slimes have crept into the old yard by the north-east city wall. Whack them and bring me their gel!

progress.1: No gel, no shine! The slimes are in the old yard by the north-east city wall.

complete.1: Ooh, nice and sticky. Hand me that sword. *CLANG* *CLANG* *hiss*
complete.2: There! Your Honed Old Sword. Every hit bites a little harder now. Come back when you have gold and materials!

a_patch_of_earth.desc: Rose has a small plot for you in the Garden. Go and see it.
a_patch_of_earth.objective: Go to your plot in the Garden

offer.1: Hello, dear. Every traveller needs a place where something grows. Even a wanderer like you.
offer.2: There is a little plot at the south end of the Garden, by the hedge. It's yours now. Go and have a look.

progress.1: Your plot is at the south end of the Garden, by the hedge. Go and stand on it.

complete.1: Lovely soil, isn't it? Here are some seeds to start with.
complete.2: We'll plant them together another day; plants need patience. Your plot keeps growing even while you are away.

tales_by_the_fire.desc: Listen to Old Bertha's tale about the Lords of Morvath.

offer.1: Come in, come in, sit by the fire! You're the one Brother Ansel found by the road, aren't you? I hear everything.
offer.2: Let me tell you a tale. Five thousand years ago, two wizards, the brothers Lucael and Baelor, did the unthinkable: they slew a god.
offer.3: They took its power and became demi-gods. They do not grow old, they do not fall ill. Folk call them the Lords of Morvath.
offer.4: Now they are necromancers. They raise slimes, goblins, skeletons and worse all over Eryndor, and their corruption spreads from the east.
offer.5: The further east you go, the darker it gets. But you... you have a stubborn look about you. Perhaps that's good.

progress.1: Sit, sit. Let an old woman tell her tale.

complete.1: Brr. Even I get the shivers telling it. Have some soup, it's on the house.
complete.2: And if you are ever stuck, come and ask Old Bertha. Somebody always knows something.

a_friend_for_the_road.desc: Marco has something for you after your fight with Sultan.

offer.1: You beat Sultan! The whole market is talking about it. A cat in disguise, who'd have thought.
offer.2: Listen, someone who fights like that will soon carry more than two arms can hold. This is Biscuit, my donkey. He's yours.
offer.3: He's stubborn, he's slow to complain and he carries a heavy load without a word. Whatever is on his back doesn't weigh on you.

complete.1: Go on, say hello. Talk to him and you can load your spare gear onto him or take it off again.
complete.2: Only remember: what Biscuit carries, you can't use. Take it out of his pack first. And not in the middle of a fight!

complete.1: Hm. Sloppy on the third, but your feet stayed where they belong.
complete.2: That is the first form. Now go and use it on something that moves.

first_form.desc: Sir Garrick gave you the Academy Blade. Hit the training dummy on the field 12 times, the way he showed you.

offer.1: So you picked the sword. Good. Hands out — no, like this. A blade is not a stick.
offer.2: Take this Academy Blade; that old thing of yours can hang over your bed. Twelve clean hits on the dummy and I will believe you were listening.

progress.1: The dummy is over there and it is not going to hit itself. Twelve, I said.

complete.1: No new scars? Either you are careful or you are lying to me.
complete.2: Keep the mantle. Out there, padding is worth more than my praise.

blade_in_the_woods.desc: Side quest: now the gate is open, Sir Garrick wants it done in the real woods — defeat 4 Goblins and 4 Green Slimes in the Greenwood of Aerandir.

offer.1: The gate is open, so here is the lesson I could not give you inside the walls.
offer.2: Four goblins, four slimes, out in the Greenwood. There is a padded mantle in it for you.

progress.1: Still work left in the woods. Four goblins and four slimes.

complete.1: Good. That is enough for the road, and the road teaches the rest.
complete.2: You have passed. The city gate is open to you — mind what is east of it.

prove_your_edge.desc: The last exam: 15 hits on the training dummy, with Sir Garrick watching.

offer.1: Last one. Fifteen hits, and I am watching every single one.
offer.2: Do not rush. A fast hit that lands beats three that do not.

complete.1: Eight out of eight, I trust? The dummy will tell me otherwise.
complete.2: Good. Now something that moves, before your aim gets comfortable.

the_arcane_shard.desc: Master Brink gave you a Mage Staff and your crystal. Hit the training dummy on the field 8 times with the Arcane Shard.

offer.1: Light is not loud. It is precise. Hold the staff — no, loosely. It is not a weapon yet.
offer.2: Your crystal is yours now. First the Arcane Shard: eight hits on the dummy at the field. It costs you nothing, so there is no excuse.

progress.1: Eight shards on the dummy at the training field. The Shard costs no mana; practise it.

complete.1: The woods are not a training field. You noticed, I can tell.
complete.2: The ring is yours. Light travels faster when the hand does.

sparks_in_the_greenwood.desc: Side quest: now the gate is open, Master Brink wants it used in the wild — defeat 4 Green Slimes and 4 Goblins in the Greenwood of Aerandir.

offer.1: You have passed, so this one is not an exam. It is a favour, and it pays.
offer.2: Four slimes, four goblins, in the Greenwood. There is a swift ring in my drawer with almost your name on it.

progress.1: Four slimes and four goblins. Watch your mana.

complete.1: There. That is focus. Keep it when you are frightened and you will keep your life.
complete.2: You have passed. The gate is open; the east is not. Not yet.

show_me_your_focus.desc: The last exam: hit the training dummy 5 times with a charged spell while Master Brink watches.

objective.train: Hit the training dummy with a charged spell {have}/{need}

offer.1: Hold the cast button. Feel it fill. Let go too early and it is a spark; hold it and it is a lesson.
offer.2: Five charged hits on the dummy. I will know if you tapped.

progress.1: Charged, I said. Hold the button until the light swells, five times.

complete.1: Hahaa — the straw is smoking. That is the Shard.
complete.2: Now something that moves. I have just the thing in the cellar.

the_first_shadow.desc: Wizard Sam gave you a Mage Staff and a Dark Crystal. Hit the training dummy on the field 8 times with the Arcane Shard.

offer.1: Dark is generous at the start. That is exactly why nobody trusts it, heh.
offer.2: Staff, crystal, and the Arcane Shard. Eight hits on that poor dummy upstairs at the field. Go on.

progress.1: Eight shards on the dummy at the training field. It costs nothing, so no whining.

complete.1: Back already? And in one piece, more or less.
complete.2: Here. It rattles when something dark is near. Probably.

shadows_in_the_greenwood.desc: Side quest: now the gate is open, Wizard Sam wants it tried out for real — defeat 4 Goblins and 4 Green Slimes in the Greenwood of Aerandir.

offer.1: No exam this time. Just me, curious about what the woods do to you.
offer.2: Four goblins, four slimes. I will trade you a goblin tooth necklace for the story.

progress.1: Four goblins and four slimes. The Greenwood is northeast.

complete.1: Hah! Did you feel that? That is what the Lords of Morvath felt like, once.
complete.2: You have passed, student. The gate is open. Do not become a story I tell later.

show_me_your_shadow.desc: The last exam: hit the training dummy 5 times with a charged spell while Wizard Sam watches.

objective.train: Hit the training dummy with a charged spell {have}/{need}

offer.1: Hold it. Let it get heavy. Dark likes to be held too long — do not let it.
offer.2: Five charged hits. If the dummy is still standing afterwards I will be very disappointed.

progress.1: Charged, not tapped. Hold the button until it swells, five times.

hold_the_line.desc: Sir Garrick calls slimes onto the training field. Hold the field through three waves.

offer.1: A dummy never hits back, so it teaches you nothing about fear. These will.
offer.2: I keep a few in a barrel behind the Academy. Three waves, each one worse than the last. Stay on the field.

progress.1: Three waves, on the field. Step off it and we start again.

complete.1: Three waves and you are still on your feet. That is what the field is for.
complete.2: One more test and the Academy is behind you.

sparks_on_the_field.desc: Master Brink calls elemental slimes onto the training field. Hold the field through three waves.

offer.1: A target that stands still teaches you distance. A target that bites teaches you timing.
offer.2: Water, fire, nature, wind — and you will not know which until it touches you. Three waves. Stay on the field.

progress.1: Three waves on the field. Watch your mana, not only your enemy.

complete.1: And you came back with mana to spare? That is the lesson, not the kills.
complete.2: One exam left. This time I want to see a charged spell.

shadows_on_the_field.desc: Wizard Sam calls dark slimes onto the training field. Hold the field through three waves.

offer.1: Slimes. I know, I know. But these have been sitting in my cellar, and the cellar changes things.
offer.2: Three waves, up on the field. Do not step off it, or we do the whole thing again.

progress.1: Three waves of dark slimes, on the field. They sap you — so hit first.

complete.1: Alive! And nothing followed you home. Mostly.
complete.2: One more. This time I want it charged — properly charged.

season.autumn_extra: Ghosts and Scarecrows roam the land.
season.winter_extra: The Frozen Lake can be reached.

controls.clickToLook: Click to look around · Esc for the menu
controls.title: Controls
controls.help: Click a key to change it. Then press a key or mouse button, or turn the wheel; Esc cancels, Backspace clears it. Ctrl + wheel always zooms the camera. The on-screen buttons on a phone stay as they are.
controls.reserved: {key} cannot be used; the game needs it.
controls.padHelp: Controller: the left stick walks, the right stick turns the camera and Start opens the menu. Click a controller slot and press a button to bind it.

touch.title: Buttons on the screen
touch.drag: Drag the buttons wherever you want them. They stay on their own side of the line.

cheats.debugViewNote: F3 cycles the size. Hidden keeps debug mode and this menu (F6) on.
cheats.title: Cheats (debug)
cheats.note: Only in debug mode, never saved.
cheats.flyHintTouch: ▲ / ▼ buttons = up and down · through walls
cheats.doorsNote: Puts every door of a Blender-built zone at a fixed angle (clamped to its stops), to check the hinges.
cheats.saveInvalid: This is not a valid save code.
cheats.measureNote: Walk around normally for {seconds} s. The result appears in the debug overlay (line "measure").
cheats.dayNightMonsters: Night monsters: {count} · test area only in debug mode
cheats.spellNote: The right button casts this spell. You get a staff with it.
cheats.aimNote: Multipliers on the numbers in player.json, to find what feels right.
cheats.lockSightNote: How long a locked enemy may be out of sight before the lock lets go (0× = at once).
cheats.animationNote: Plays one clip on its own, over and over, while you keep walking. Auto follows the game again.

bag.title: Bag
bag.noQuests: No quests right now. Talk to the people of Greyhaven.
bag.padInCombat: During a fight the bag cannot be opened with a controller yet.
bag.liveFight: The fight goes on while the bag is open. Only potions can be used now.

load.mediumMessage: Medium load: your dash is a bit shorter.
load.heavyMessage: Heavy load: you walk slower, dash short and need a moment to get up.
load.overloadedMessage: Overloaded: you walk very slowly and cannot dash. Put something away.
load.lightMessage: Light load: you move freely again.

death.title: You were defeated
death.goldLost: You lost {amount} {gold}. You wake up at your checkpoint. It lies where you fell.
death.wakeUp: You wake up at your checkpoint.

forge.title: Forge
forge.inCombat: Not now, you are in a fight.
forge.empty: You have no weapon Hilda can upgrade.

sultan.retry: Back again? Try to keep up!
sultan.enrage: Not bad… Now I'm getting serious!
sultan.win: Heh… you've got claws after all. You're ready for the world out there.

hint.claw: His claws light up: step back or dash away!
hint.pounce: He crouches, eyes glowing: dash sideways!
hint.charge: A red line: get off it before he runs!
hint.flurry: Flurry! Get away, then strike while he catches his breath.
hint.strikeTouch: He stands still: tap Attack now!
hint.guard: He dodges everything. Wait until he stands still after an attack.

victory.title: BOND FORGED
victory.subtitle: A guardian has found his equal

pack.title: {name}'s pack
pack.note: What {name} carries does not count for your load, but you can't use it until you take it out.

world.loadFailed: This place could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

garrick_field_drill.start: Barrel is open. Feet apart, eyes up — here they come.

wave.2: That was the warm-up. The next one is bigger.
wave.3: Last wave, and I put the fat one in. Do not back into a dummy.

garrick_field_drill.reset: Off the field, off the exam. Come back and we start at the first wave.

brink_field_drill.start: Four elements, and I never tell them which to send. Begin.

wave.2: Again, and more of them. Keep your distance; distance is the spell before the spell.
wave.3: The big one carries the same element as the small ones. Learn it before it touches you.

brink_field_drill.end: Clean. Mana left, feet dry, and you are still standing.
brink_field_drill.reset: You left the field, so the lesson left with you. From the first wave, please.

sam_field_drill.start: Up you go, little ones. Do try to hurt the student.

wave.2: More! They get braver when there are more of them. So do people.
wave.3: And the fat one. When it pops you get two more — that is the joke.

sam_field_drill.end: Hah! Not one of them left. I liked those slimes.
sam_field_drill.reset: Oh, you walked away. Fine, fine. From the beginning then.

spellbook.title: Spellbook
spellbook.noStaff: Equip a staff to use the spellbook.
spellbook.noSpells: You do not know any spells yet.
spellbook.noSlots: This staff has no spell slots.
spellbook.hint: Your cast button fires the selected slot; {keySpellNext} picks the next one, also in a fight. Which spells sit in the slots can only be changed outside a fight.
